notes.title: Welcome to the FNA, recruit.
notes.content:
The breach is open. Are you ready to teleport?

At O5 Interactive, we're thrilled to officially welcome you to Breach Signal, our debut psychological horror co-op game for 1-6 players. Take a look at our very first Reveal Trailer:

[previewyoutube=l1eqP72DDEs;full][/previewyoutube]
About Breach Signal

You’ve been recruited into the [REDACTED] program, an initiative led by the Federal Normality Agency. Your mission? Lead expeditions into unstable zones, investigate reality-breaking anomalies, and return with samples the Agency can use… if you make it back.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068387/3e4a96ddd1a6d14c42df20ccafb438674b6124a4.png

 Team up with up to 5 other players
 Use proximity voice chat or your Talkie
 Deploy retro-futuristic investigation tools
 Locate Anchor Objects and collect samples
 Face dynamic threats and randomized objectives
The world of Breach Signal is inspired by 80s retro sci-fi, cosmic horror, and bureaucratic secrecy, where analog tech meets unexplainable phenomena...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45068387/4c4235601ade8b3ab77b5b96015c73cc5752ee07.png
Welcome to the Expedition

We’re just getting started. As we continue development, we’ll be sharing more peeks into the tools, anomalies, and secrets of Breach Signal. Join us, help shape the future of the project, and prepare for what’s coming next!

Access Granted: join the discussion on Discord
Follow our FNA Networks to stay alert to classified updates.
Wishlist Breach Signal to support the mission: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2546650/Breach_Signal/
Stay sharp out there, recruit. The signal is… unstable.
